name: Origin Dollar Vault mintMultiple reentrancy
summary: VaultCore.mintMultiple() skipped the supported-asset check that mint() performed, so the attacker passed a self-controlled fake stablecoin whose transferFrom re-entered the vault and triggered a rebase between the first mint's asset transfer and its OUSD supply increase, minting more OUSD than the vault held in assets.
notes: The last of 11 pre-incident Upgraded events selected the defect-bearing Vault implementation from topic 1.

Origin's project post-mortem reports a $7 million loss. PeckShield independently estimated approximately $7.7 million, including 11,809 ETH and 2,249,821 DAI, so the record retains Origin's rounded first-party gross-loss figure without presenting the reported token quantities as exact structured components.
The $7 million gross loss is Origin's rounded project-reported USD figure; PeckShield's independent estimate is approximately $7.7 million.
